name: Pricing
sourceRefs: apiv/dzero lib/dzero/segments/11_pricing.rb (field-id-to-symbol dictionary, read directly) cross-confirmed against eduardonunesp/ncpdp-telecom-fmt-book docs/segments.md's own worked Pricing Segment (AM11) example.

ingredientCostSubmitted/dispensingFeeSubmitted/patientPaidAmountSubmitted/grossAmountDue (D9/DC/DX/DU) width=8, dataType RO, places=2 -- directly, byte-for-byte confirmed from data-types.md's own worked examples (D9=0000057A->5.71, DC=0000027E->2.75, DX=0000016B->1.62, DU=0000084F->8.46, each exactly 8 raw characters).

usualAndCustomaryCharge (DQ) is a REAL, sourced correction from an initial draft of this schema: the segments.md worked example's own raw byte sequence ('DQ00000000') has NO trailing overpunch letter -- 8 plain digits, unlike its 3 sibling amount fields in the SAME example which all end in a letter (D9=...A, DC=...E, DX=...B, DU=...F). Modeled as dataType R (plain decimal), not RO -- Usual and Customary Charge is inherently non-negative, consistent with not needing a sign-carrying encoding.

Every other field in this segment (BE/E3/H7/H8/H9/HA/GE/HE/JE/DN/N3) has NO independently-confirmed width in either source's own worked examples -- width left unset (no zero-padding enforced on build) rather than guessing a plausible-looking number, matching this codebase's own discipline of never fabricating unconfirmed structural detail. percentageSalesTaxRateSubmitted's own places=4 is likewise an educated placement (percentage rates conventionally carry more implied precision than dollar amounts), not independently confirmed.
